description: Return a bounded one-based term of the Hofstadter-Conway $10,000 sequence.

source.title: Hofstadter-Conway $10,000 sequence (OEIS A004001)
source.author: John Conway
source.publication: T. Kubo and R. Vakil, On Conway's recursive sequence, Discrete Mathematics 152 (1996), 225-252.
source.recurrence_source: Eric W. Weisstein, Hofstadter-Conway $10,000 Sequence, MathWorld
source.independent_method_source: Clean-room explicit dependency-stack evaluation derived from the defining recurrence
source.source_license: Sources consulted for the recurrence and mathematical properties only; all implementations, fixtures, and reference code are clean-room.

workspace.meaning: One fixed 8193-element signed 64-bit recurrence table; no other dynamic workspace.

contract.seeds: a(1)=a(2)=1; index 1 is an internal seed and is not an accepted input index.
contract.definedness: The profile computes the recurrence for every input index from 2 through 8192. By induction, 1<=a(k)<=k, so both recurrence dependencies are positive indices less than n.
contract.primary_method: Fill a fixed table in increasing index order.
contract.independent_method: Use a demand-driven explicit dependency stack with memoized terms; this does not fill the prefix in increasing order.
contract.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) words for the primary; the dependency-stack reference memoizes at most n terms.
contract.workspace_proof: The only native recurrence storage is 8193 signed 64-bit values: 8193*8=65544 bytes. Every term is at most its one-based index, hence output and additions fit signed 64-bit.
contract.error_precedence: Reject null input, parseable lengths outside 1..2, any length other than 1, non-signed-64-bit words, and indices outside 2..8192 before recurrence evaluation.
